description: Use this when asking 'How much should I budget to remodel my kitchen based on its size and finishes?' or 'Can you help me make a kitchen remodel budget with separate labor and material costs?'. Size and scope return a national planning estimate range rounded to the nearest 100 dollars, with no published typical figure, two separate dated reference cards and sources. The result has no line items or labor/material split: the published bands include both, and no public source we trust splits them for a typical kitchen. Pure arithmetic, no network or model. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

area_sqft.description: Kitchen floor area in square feet, 20–1,000. Use area OR length and width.

length_ft.description: Kitchen length in feet; requires width_ft instead of area_sqft. Product must be 20–1,000 sq ft.

scope.description: partial: $60–$150/sq ft, may include DIY work; full: $150–$250/sq ft, same layout; layout_change: $250–$350/sq ft, layout changes / high-end. Bands include labor and materials.

width_ft.description: Kitchen width in feet; requires length_ft instead of area_sqft. Product must be 20–1,000 sq ft.

name: kitchen_remodel_cost
title: Kitchen Remodel Cost Estimator
